title: SM-09.20 - Whether Email Reports include personal data
intent: This article answers: SM-09.20 - Whether Email Reports include personal data
short_answer: No. Email Reports contain only the number of contributions received. They do not include personal data or sensitive data from respondents.
important_conditions: The report is designed to provide participation monitoring without exposing respondent answers.
